All three have london_authority Enfield. The canonical file contains point carriers only, with no exact building polygon, Overture GERS ID or UPRN.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Current release, schema version and public data retention policy.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Overture Documentation Releases identifies 2026-07-22.0 as the current data release and v1.18.0 as its schema version. Public AWS and Azure release data is retained for a maximum of 60 days, so scripts must discover the current release instead of assuming an old path.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Building semantics, current public cloud paths and ODbL.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The Overture Buildings Guide defines building geometry as the outer footprint or roofprint and exposes the 2026-07-22.0 building dataset on public Amazon S3 and Microsoft Azure paths. The building theme combines open datasets and is published under ODbL.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: STAC root/latest and building collection metadata contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Overture's STAC catalog is the machine-readable release index. The root catalog exposes a latest release; a building collection URL follows the form /<release>/buildings/building/collection.json. Collection metadata includes feature count, license, columns and item links to parquet assets before data is downloaded.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: GeoParquet cloud distribution and metadata-first access.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Overture publishes monthly global map data as GeoParquet on Amazon S3 and Microsoft Azure. The STAC catalog includes spatial extents, feature counts, column names and links to GeoParquet files; users can scan only needed cloud chunks instead of downloading the entire dataset.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Building identity, bbox and allowed geometry types.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The Overture building schema provides id, bbox and geometry fields. Building geometry is a footprint or roofprint and the allowed geometry types are Polygon and MultiPolygon. A GERS-associated id is not equivalent to an HMLR INSPIRE ID or UPRN without independent binding proof.
